12 /**
13  * First non-empty string token (trim). Empty / whitespace → null.
14  * @param {unknown} value
15  * @returns {string | null}
16  */
17 export function nonEmptyToken(value) {
18   if (value == null) return null;
19   const s = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : String(value).trim();
20   return s ? s : null;
21 }
22 
23 /**
24  * L1 depth chain — first non-empty wins:
25  * explicit arg → GANDALF_DEPTH → FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_DEPTH
26  * @param {{ depth?: unknown, env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string|undefined> }} [opts]
27  * @returns {string | null}
28  */
29 export function pickGandalfDepth({ depth = null, env = process.env } = {}) {
30   const e = env && typeof env === 'object' ? env : {};
31   return (
32     nonEmptyToken(depth) ||
33     nonEmptyToken(e.GANDALF_DEPTH) ||
34     nonEmptyToken(e.FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_DEPTH) ||
35     null
36   );
37 }
38 
39 /**
40  * L1 tier chain — first non-empty wins:
41  * explicit arg → GANDALF_TIER → FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_TIER
42  * @param {{ tier?: unknown, env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string|undefined> }} [opts]
43  * @returns {string | null}
44  */
45 export function pickGandalfTier({ tier = null, env = process.env } = {}) {
46   const e = env && typeof env === 'object' ? env : {};
47   return (
48     nonEmptyToken(tier) ||
49     nonEmptyToken(e.GANDALF_TIER) ||
50     nonEmptyToken(e.FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_TIER) ||
51     null
52   );
53 }
54 
55 /**
56  * Production lock trigger (L1): locked iff any of explicit depth|tier or the four
57  * env names is set (non-empty after trim). GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS is never a lock.
58  *
59  * @param {{ depth?: unknown, tier?: unknown, env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string|undefined> }} [opts]
60  * @returns {boolean}
61  */
62 export function isGandalfBandLocked({ depth = null, tier = null, env = process.env } = {}) {
63   return Boolean(pickGandalfDepth({ depth, env }) || pickGandalfTier({ tier, env }));
64 }
65 
66 /**
67  * L4 exclusive unlock predicate — true iff ALL lock inputs are absent/empty:
68  * no explicit depth|tier and none of the four lock envs. GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS is
69  * never a lock input (unlocked may still carry a legacy env cap elsewhere).
70  *
71  * @param {{ depth?: unknown, tier?: unknown, env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string|undefined> }} [opts]
72  * @returns {boolean}
73  */
74 export function isGandalfBandUnlocked({ depth = null, tier = null, env = process.env } = {}) {
75   return !isGandalfBandLocked({ depth, tier, env });
76 }
77 
78 /**
79  * Safety floor (L4/L5): seats must be present and non-empty. Refuse band-thin
80  * knobs that zero or omit seats — never silently thin past the seats floor.
81  *
82  * @param {object | null | undefined} knobs
83  * @returns {object} knobs (same reference) when valid
84  * @throws {Error} when seats are missing, empty, or numeric zero
85  */
86 export function assertGandalfSeatsFloor(knobs) {
87   if (!knobs || typeof knobs !== 'object') {
88     throw new Error('gandalf band-thin refused: knobs missing (seats floor)');
89   }
90   const seats = knobs.seats;
91   if (seats == null) {
92     throw new Error('gandalf band-thin refused: seats floor violated (seats missing)');
93   }
94   if (typeof seats === 'number' && (!Number.isFinite(seats) || seats <= 0)) {
95     throw new Error('gandalf band-thin refused: seats floor violated (seats zeroed)');
96   }
97   if (typeof seats === 'string' && seats.trim() === '') {
98     throw new Error('gandalf band-thin refused: seats floor violated (seats empty)');
99   }
100   if (Array.isArray(seats) && seats.length === 0) {
101     throw new Error('gandalf band-thin refused: seats floor violated (seats empty)');
102   }
103   return knobs;
104 }

106 /**
107  * Resolve Gandalf band knobs from CLI / env / explicit lock.
108  * Precedence (L1): explicit depth/tier → GANDALF_* → FOUNDRY_TRIAGE_* → recommend+confirm when allowDefault.
109  * When any lock input is set, resolveSkillLock failures hard-fail (no advisory soft-pick).
110  *
111  * @param {object} [opts]
112  * @param {string} [opts.depth]
113  * @param {string} [opts.tier]
114  * @param {object} [opts.intake]
115  * @param {boolean} [opts.allowDefault=true]  when true, confirm recommended band if unlocked
116  * @param {object} [opts.env]
117  * @returns {{ knobs: object, lock: object|null, recommendation: object, source: string }}
118  */
119 export function resolveGandalfBand({
120   depth = null,
121   tier = null,
122   intake = {},
123   allowDefault = true,
124   env = process.env,
125 } = {}) {
126   const d = pickGandalfDepth({ depth, env });
127   const t = pickGandalfTier({ tier, env });
128   const hasLockInput = Boolean(d || t);
129 
130   const recommendation = recommendForSkill('gandalf', {
131     ...intake,
132     depth: d || undefined,
133     tier: t || undefined,
134   });
135 
136   if (hasLockInput || allowDefault) {
137     try {
138       const resolved = resolveSkillLock('gandalf', {
139         inputs: intake,
140         confirmedDepth: d || recommendation.depth,
141         confirmedTier: t || recommendation.tier,
142         decision: 'confirm',
143         recommendation,
144       });
145       // Lock path: refuse thinning that zeros seats (L4/L5 safety floor).
146       if (hasLockInput) assertGandalfSeatsFloor(resolved.knobs);
147       return {
148         knobs: resolved.knobs,
149         lock: resolved.lock,
150         recommendation,
151         source: hasLockInput ? 'explicit' : 'recommend-confirm',
152       };
153     } catch (err) {
154       // Fail-closed on lock input: never soft-pick advisory / invent FULL.
155       if (hasLockInput || !allowDefault) throw err;
156     }
157   }
158 
159   // Last resort advisory knobs (not a lock) — stamped unlocked for honesty.
160   const knobs = knobsForSkill('gandalf', recommendation.depth, recommendation.tier);
161   return {
162     knobs,
163     lock: null,
164     recommendation,
165     source: 'advisory',
166   };
167 }
